name: design
description: Portable design craft as a skill — grounds UI in semantic tokens + a known component substrate (shadcn/Tailwind/lucide), rejects the looks AI defaults to, and spends motion deliberately. Reads a per-repo BRAND.md for brand-specific tokens. `generate`/`apply` modes derive and enforce that brand automatically instead of it being hand-maintained, against a versioned, schema-validated contract (CONTRACT.md + tokens.schema.json) so every installed repo gets the identical standard.
